exact_ideal_legal_probability.target: report exact value; no sampling precision target

mechanism.stratified_bootstrap: preserve SC/VSC pairing and policy seeds within blocks; equal family weight

monte_carlo_operational.reason: Eligible simulator-outcome pilot requires operational evaluator with separate train/online/final random banks and event-keyed CRN; unavailable/unaffordable here. Do not substitute surrogate A2 objective variation for simulated race-outcome uncertainty.
